import inspect

import pytest

import invoices.export as export


def test_upload_signature():
    assert callable(export.upload)
    assert list(inspect.signature(export.upload).parameters) == ['invoice_path', 'customer']

def test_find_customer_signature():
    assert callable(export.find_customer)
    assert list(inspect.signature(export.find_customer).parameters) == ['db', 'name']
